name: Rocky Trail
desc1: This rough trail leads upwards in a fairly steep climb, with many
desc2: large rocks making it a troublesome journey. The air at this elevation
desc3: is quite crisp and cool, and gets colder the higher you go up. Along
desc4: the side of the trail you occasionally see the discarded remains of
desc5: some decomposed animal. Off to the south, you can see a strange
desc6: structure nestled upon the edge of a lofty crag.
